Marketplace

Ready-to-use example sites with search templates

Mythical Creatures

A fantasy bestiary search site featuring dragons, griffins, phoenixes and more. Includes faceted search and a React SPA template.

Space Missions

Explore historic and fictional space missions with semantic search. Features mission data, crew information, and launch details.

Vinyl Records

A music catalog search site for vinyl records. Browse albums by artist, genre, year and label with a retro-styled search template.
